entries.author: Prinz_Land
entries.text:
Advice to #Bitcoin Leverage Traders:

Trade only $BTC and do your analysis very well before entering a trade. Set your SL at -20% to -30%.

When you hit SL, try again. When you hit another SL, try again. When you blow your account, deposit again. …
entries.suggested_post:
Leverage trading plan:

Hit your stop loss. Try again.
Hit it again. Try again.
Blow the account. Deposit again.

Or just buy spot and go to sleep.
entries.image_alt: Trader pressing a Deposit Again button in front of a falling chart
